description: The specified canonical extension \(\widehat v\) satisfies the Tseitin clause list \(T(A)\) if and only if \(\llbracket A\rrbracket_v=1\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.encoding_extend.{u} {α : Type u}
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.ListModels (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TseitinEncoding.extend v)
